bullets.text: Minister Dr. R. Kumar inspected the rainwater removal work in Velachery, stating his primary role as an MLA precedes his ministerial duties.
Polimer News reported on Velachery floating in floodwaters with 20 motors deployed, raising questions about what the next official action will be.
Velachery residents told Deccan Chronicle that emergency pumping is essential but cannot substitute for a long-term flood mitigation plan.
Heavy rain lashed Chennai and neighbouring districts, leading authorities to declare school holidays in Chennai, Thiruvallur, Kancheepuram, and Chengalpattu.
A 23-year-old man named Yuvraj died near Gummidipoondi after a crane collided with his bike, according to Dinamalar.
Sathiyam News reported knee-deep water on the OMR road, causing severe distress for motorists in Taramani.
Motorists faced severe distress in Pallikaranai due to a combination of rain and traffic jams as covered by Sathiyam News.
Heavy rain caused water to flood residential areas in Ponneri and Minjur, as reported by DinaMani.
Tiruvallur District Collector S. Kavitha released the draft polling booth list covering the district's 10 assembly constituencies.
The water inflow into Puzhal Lake in Tiruvallur district increased to 1,126 cusecs from the previous day's 775 cusecs.
Vultr and AMD are expanding AI infrastructure by deploying AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs in a new 20 MW supercluster in Chennai.
Tamil Nadu has begun procuring computer and IT equipment to modernise courts under Phase-III of the national eCourts programme.
MeitY formed a team to investigate an eMudhra security incident involving certificates issued with dangerously weak secret keys.
DinaMani reported that 200 farmers were arrested in Thiruvallur district after holding a road blockade demanding full crop loan waivers.
Red Pix 24x7 reported allegations involving ED regarding data center and industrial project approvals during the DMK rule.
Chief Minister Vijay launched an awareness campaign highlighting the importance of rainwater harvesting, according to DinaMani.
